answer: Agents stake collateral into a shared willow-shaped Merkle registry, where each identity must submit a succinct zk-SNARK proving unique enrollment over a pairing-friendly curve cycle before claiming nectar rewards. Recursive proof composition lets validators aggregate these enrollment proofs into a single plume of constant-size verification, so duplicate identities cannot. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
